price_mapping_rule: Every current price and baseline is joined by ticker key only; array-index zipping is forbidden.
execution_rule: New-position eligibility requires ticker-key mapping + price_integrity_ok=true + final freshness fresh=true. stale/integrity-failed observations may remain diagnostic but cannot authorize execution or update trusted return/extrema.
extrema_rule: MFE/MAE use Bithumb 1-minute candle highs/lows plus direct trusted ticker snapshots. 24h final price uses the latest trusted in-window ticker sample or last completed 1m close, whichever is later.

official_group_policy.rule: A group with 1-4 official rows remains fully official and receives the same MFE/final-price feedback as a five-row group.

1.denominator_rule: Use actual official_selected_count, never an assumed five.

2.denominator_rule: Use actual official_selected_count, never an assumed five.

4.denominator_rule: Use actual official_selected_count, never an assumed five.

summary.feedback_output_order: MFE -> current/final price -> current/final return -> peak giveback
summary.rule: Detection success, official recognition, execution eligibility, MFE, final price and profit retention are separate. Missing slots are never auto-filled and do not invalidate the rows that were actually sealed.
